jobs.occupation: Revit Modeler / Technical Draftsman for Interior and Exterior Design
jobs.description:
As a Revit Modeler, you will be responsible for the technical development of both interior and exterior aspects of various projects. You will translate designs into accurate 3D models and technical drawings, ensuring attention to detail and functionality. Collaborating with architects, designers, and other specialists, you will contribute to high-quality construction projects. Key responsibilities include: Setting up and managing Revit models for both interior and exterior projects. Developing technical details and drawings in compliance with applicable building and safety standards. Coordinating with other disciplines within the project team. Reviewing designs for feasibility and technical execution. Contributing to the optimization of workflows and standards within the organization. Bedrijfsinformatie Our client is dedicated to technical design and innovation. The company specializes in designing and delivering high-quality interior and exterior solutions. With a passion for architecture and a strong focus on collaboration, the team translates clients' visions into practical, technical designs. Their projects range from residential homes to commercial buildings, where creativity meets technical precision. Working with this organization means being part of a close-knit team that strives for quality and craftsmanship at every stage of a project. Functie-eisen We are looking for an enthusiastic and detail-oriented professional who meets the following criteria: Education & Experience: Completed education in architecture, construction engineering, or interior design. A minimum of 2 years of experience as a Revit Modeler or Technical Draftsman. Skills: Excellent proficiency in Revit (experience with AutoCAD is a plus). Knowledge of construction standards and regulations. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. Good communication skills in English Personality: Proactive, eager to learn, and solution-oriented. A team player who thrives in a dynamic environment

Arbeidsvoorwaarden You will work in an inspiring environment with opportunities for personal growth and development. Our client offers: An attractive salary based on your experience and expertise. Opportunities for training and courses to further develop your skills. A hybrid work model with flexible working hours. A challenging position within an ambitious and growing company. A friendly work atmosphere with supportive colleagues! Contactinformatie Wil je meer informatie over deze vacature?
